description: Set Paragraph panel attributes on text frames, some of their paragraphs, or the selected text: alignment, indents, space before and after, hyphenation (the Hyphenation dialog), word and letter spacing, glyph scaling and auto leading (the Justification dialog), single-word justification, composer, Roman hanging punctuation, kashida width, and the CJK options (kinsoku, mojikumi, burasagari, bunri-kinshi, kurikaeshi moji shori, leading type)

afterFirst.description: At least this many letters before a hyphen

autoLeadingAmount.description: Auto leading, percent of the font size

beforeLast.description: At least this many letters after a hyphen

composer.description: Composer: Adobe Single-line or Every-line, or the Middle Eastern and South Asian ones

hyphenLimit.description: Most consecutive hyphenated lines (0 = no limit)

kashidaWidth.description: Kashida width for justified Arabic text

kinsoku.description: Kinsoku Shori set by name, e.g. "None", "Hard", "Soft"

leadingType.description: Leading measured top to top or bottom to bottom

paragraphs.description: Paragraphs to format in each frame: start is the 0-based paragraph index; length defaults to the rest. Default: every paragraph

singleWordJustification.description: How a line holding a single word is justified

spaceAfter.description: Space after the paragraph in points

spaceBefore.description: Space before the paragraph in points

target.description: Which items to act on. Give ids (from list_items or a create tool), names, or selection: true. Text frames inside groups are included; with selection: true and text selected with the Type tool, the selected text is used

names.description: Item names (every item with each name)

wordsLongerThan.description: Hyphenate words longer than this many letters

name: set_paragraph_attributes
title: Set Paragraph Attributes
